newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI says no plans to give Palmer job.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI says no plans to give Palmer job.

text.p: Heavy engineering group Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Monday it had no plans to employ former director Ross Palmer as a consultant.
The Australian Financial Review reported on Monday that ANI plans to employ Palmer as a consultant.

Referring to the newspaper report, ANI said it had discussed with Palmer arrangements whereby he might provide consultancy services to ANI mainly in relation to its unit the Welded Tube Company in North America.
"These discussions have terminated and there is no plan to engage Mr Palmer in that capacity," ANI said.
Palmer sold his five percent stake in ANI after shareholders voted to remove Palmer from the board in October.
Palmer's removal from the board followed a dispute with fellow directors over the board's handling of the purchase of German environmental waste business ABT by its Holter unit of Germany.
ANI shares closed steady at A$1.27.
